sources.title: [2602.19141] Sycophantic Chatbots Cause Delusional Spiraling, Even in ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we probe the causal link between AI sycophancy and AI-induced psychosis through modeling and simulation. We propose a simple Bayesian model of a user conversing with a chatbot, and formalize notions of sycophancy and delusional spiraling in that model.
